import requests

url = "https://example.com/big.bin"
output_file = "big.bin"
chunk_size = 8192

response = requests.get(url, stream=True)
response.raise_for_status()

with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
    for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
        if chunk:
            f.write(chunk)
